summary: Web V2 sidebar-only usability fix: auto-reveal the active child session after asynchronous parent-map loading, flatten matching search results, and support session-ID search. No new control authority, persistence schema, backend endpoint, deployment behavior, or model selection.

components.owning_subsystem: Web V2 client-only sidebar session tree and search presentation
components.disposition: Admit a small presentation correction: when the current session is a child, expand its ancestor chain once topology loads; when searching, show all matching sessions as independent visible rows and allow ID matches. Manual collapse remains available. No changes to authoritative session metadata, Goal, lane, or access controls.
evidence: Observed live W1 child session 5a331d35-335d-4ca3-9a84-cf13f694d86c has parent_id 1a7bb31d-f3da-497f-9322-336483f4435a, and appears in /api/v1/sessions but is hidden under default collapsed tree.
Isolated worktree 20261116: 13/13 focused sidebar tests PASS; 603/603 WebUI tests PASS; TypeScript typecheck PASS; WebUI build PASS; git diff --check PASS.
New regression tests cover async active child, switch and manual collapse, simultaneous parent/child search, and session-ID search.
components.verification_level: Local focused + full WebUI tests and build PASS; independent Reviewer, original full R9 and remote CI required before merge/deploy.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: No model evidence, veto, recovery or exit authority is introduced. Parent topology and current-session ID are read-only server-derived facts; UI only adjusts presentation. On missing tree data, existing flat rendering remains.
components.rollback_route: Revert this PR and rebuild Web V2 through the existing managed release path; session JSON and parent-child relationships remain untouched.
